We are a multidisciplinary team passionate about technology, innovation, and space exploration. Our interests and skills include software development, coding, web development, hardware, machine learning, and data management.

We believe that teamwork, curiosity, and continuous learning are essential for innovation. Our goal is to use technology, data, and creative thinking to turn ideas into meaningful solutions and contribute to a better understanding of our world and beyond.
summary: MARSWALK is a navigation app developed by team 7-TeraByte to make human research on Mars safer and faster. Using real NASA datasets-including HiRISE elevation models, THEMIS mosaics, CRISM parameters and Curiosity rover data-it lets astronauts use pre-configured routes or generate custom paths based on slope and elevation. Its dynamic routing calculates alternative routes for changing conditions. Unlike toolsfor unmanned rovers, MARSWALK prioritizes human safety with a simple, zero-learning-curve 2D/3D interface. By minimizing terrain hazards, it maximizies mission efficiency. Its algorithm also suits future space missions, disaster relief and search-and-rescue
details:
What It Does And How It Works

MARSWALK is an interactive 2D and 3D surface navigation system designed to assist astronauts during planetary exploration on Mars. Users can select pre-planned mission routes or define custom start and end points. By processing user-defined parameters such as terrain slope,elevation, radiation levels, and walking models (incorporating Tobler’s hiking function and Apollo lunar gait studies), the routing engine calculates the safest and most optimal path. If terrain or mission conditions change, the system dynamically generates real-time alternative routes.

Key Benefits And Intended Impact

- Safety: Proactively analyzes hazardous terrain features-such as steep slopes, deep craters and high mountains to minimize life threatening risks for astronauts.

- Efficiency: Optimizes travel paths and mission duration, allowing crews to spend more time conducting high value geological and scientific research

- Flexibility: Instantly recalculates alternative pathways when unexpected obstacles or changing enviromental conditions arise.

- Broader Impact: Increases the success rate of future crewed Mars missions. We envision MARSWALK being integrated directly into astronaut helmet displays and exploration rovers on Mars and other celestial bodies. Furthermore, its adaptive terrain-routing technology can be applied on Earth in disaster zones, search-and-rescue operations, and autonomous off-road navigation.

Creativity & Unique Features Unlike existing space mission software built primarily for engineers operating unmanned rovers, MARSWALK puts human safety and usability at its center. Instead of complex engineering dashboards, it offers an intuitive, zero-learning-curve interface with seamless 2D and 3D multi-angle visualization powered by real NASA datasets.

Tools, Software & Data Sources

-Frontend & Visualization: Three.js (r149), HTML/CSS/JavaScript, IBM Plex Sans/Mono typography.

-Data Processing & Backend: Python, Rasterio / GDAL, NumPy, SciPy, Pillow, Playwright, FFmpeg.

-NASA & Scientific Data: HiRISE 1m DEM & 25cm Orthophoto Mosaics, THEMIS Nighttime IR Mosaic, CRISM MTRDR Mineral Parameters, Curiosity Rover Traverse/Waypoints/REMS Weather APIs, NASA DONKI Space Weather API, Curiosity RAD radiation data, and NASA-STD-3001 radiation standards.
